job: Review the actual current GT3 RS asset under neutral commercial studio lighting.

value.camera: Moderately compressed automotive perspective; 65 mm front/rear, 70 mm side, 75 mm wheel detail.
value.focus: Depth of field disabled so relevant geometry and finish remain readable.
value.lighting: Camera-relative neutral D65-white area lights; overhead key, approximately 2:1 key/fill emitter-radiance ratio, narrow lower-power rim and narrow front fill.
value.color: White paint and red wheel/graphics colors remain unchanged; no product color grading.
value.materials: Preserve the actual GLB factors, maps, geometry and rig. Adjust light-card size/direction to inspect carbon and glazing without broad white reflections.
value.composition: Read silhouette and white/red design first, then aero and wheel detail. Large neutral floor avoids visible plane edges.

decisions.rationale: The first lighting setup produced broad specular reflections that hid dark carbon and headlamp detail.

soft_warnings: Studio appearance is not a native-game rendering or performance proof.
unresolved: Inspect all four updated views for washed-out dark trim, glare, geometry fit and readable finish.
recommended_next: Render the front view, inspect it, then complete the matching rear, side and wheel views.
